recipes.label: Get started
recipes.prompt: Help me set up Orendro for the things I actually want to track. Read my existing setup first and avoid asking questions I have already answered. Ask one question at a time. Let me start logging before optional profile or goal setup is finished. Help me complete one useful action, then ask whether I want a daily review, a conditional food check-in, or optional purchase-evidence suggestions. Check what this assistant can actually schedule and access before offering activation. Tell me separately what is saved in Orendro and what is scheduled in this assistant. Do not activate a routine I have not chosen.
recipes.output: Confirmed saved result or an accurate draft/setup-needed state
triggers: Get started

recipes.label: Choose my daily review
recipes.prompt: Help me configure a daily Orendro review. Ask which parts I want included, what time and timezone to use, which days, and whether I want a review every time or only when something needs attention. Preview the format using my available records, clearly labeling missing data. Check that scheduled runs here can read my Orendro connection. If I ask you to activate it, create or update the appropriate task and confirm its actual schedule and identifier. If that is not supported, give me the completed setup prompt and say it has not been scheduled. Do not change my goals or create food records as part of the review.
recipes.output: Confirmed saved result or an accurate draft/setup-needed state
triggers: Choose my daily review

recipes.label: Set up an evening check-in
recipes.prompt: At [time] on [days] in [timezone], check my Orendro food log for the current local day. If [specific meal or logging condition] has no matching record, ask one brief question about whether I want to add anything. If the condition is already satisfied, stay quiet using this client's supported notification behavior. Do not assume I skipped eating, and do not create a food record from a reminder alone. If you cannot read Orendro, report that the check failed according to the failure rule we choose. Verify the connection and show me the exact rule before scheduling it. Confirm only what the scheduler actually creates.
recipes.output: Confirmed saved result or an accurate draft/setup-needed state
triggers: Set up an evening check-in

recipes.label: Review purchase evidence automatically
recipes.prompt: Help me set up optional purchase-evidence suggestions for Orendro. Ask which connected source I want to use, which merchants or message types, and the date range. Explain separately how grocery purchases could update inventory and how food orders could become meal-log suggestions. Check the connection and whether this client supports an incoming-message trigger or a bounded scheduled search. I want you to show proposed records and ask before saving them. Do not assume I ate everything I purchased. Check for duplicate orders and existing logs. Do not read unrelated messages, modify my mailbox, or create a routine until I choose to activate it.
recipes.output: Confirmed saved result or an accurate draft/setup-needed state
